content.hebrew: אֹמֵן, בַּחֲזוֹת כְּבוֹד אֵל וְהִשִּׂיג מִדּוֹתָיו,
content.transliteration: Omen, baḥazot kevod El vehissiḡ middotav,
content.english: When the nurse saw God’s Glory, and apprehended His attributes,
The veil was removed from his thoughts.

content.hebrew: רָד מִסִּינַי, וּבְיָדוֹ שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת עֵדוֹתָיו,
content.english: He descended [Mount] Sinai, with the two Tablets of Testimony in his hands,
And his lips were full of sparks of wisdom.
He assembled the Israelites together,
And said to them to observe His Sabbaths,
That no persons should allow a fire to burn in their dwellings.
They should take donations of their own [possessions] for Adonai,
Everyone with a giving spirit should bring gifts,
To make the Tabernacle and its courtyard—
With twenty planks, and their two pegs [each];
And [the Tabernacle]’s cover—its awning of goats[’ hides];
And on the extreme edge, its fifty loops,

content.transliteration: Veḳarsē neḥoshet, leḥabber et ha’ohel bemaḥberotav,
content.english: And bronze clasps, to join the tent at its joints;
And its cover—[hides] dyed red, and hides of taḥash;
content.comments: Taḥash. An unknown kind of hide.

content.hebrew: וְהָאָרֹן, וְאַרְבַּע טַבְּעוֹתָיו עַל אַרְבַּע פַּעֲמוֹתָיו,
content.english: And the Ark, and the four rings on its four corners,
And its poles, going through the rings on its sides;
And the table, with its rim and its border;
And the candelabrum for light, and its lamps;
And the incense altar, with its horns coming from it;
And the altar for sacrifices and burnt offerings,
And its horns at its four corners;
And the laver, and the courtyard, with its pegs.
[All these must be] the handiwork of a craftsman, who designs with his knowledge,

content.transliteration: Beno Uri, vekhol ḥakham lev ba‘atsotav.
content.english: The son of Uri, and everyone whose heart is adept at planning.

content.hebrew: כִּי יוי יִתֵּן חָכְמָה, לְרֹב תְּהִלּוֹתָיו.
content.transliteration: Ki Adonai yitten ḥokhma lerov tehillotav.
content.english: For Adonai gives wisdom, [making] Him [worthy] of great praise.
He told the Israelites His deeds,

content.transliteration: Moshi’a‘ verav veḡo’el le‘ammo mikkol tsarotav,
content.english: He rescues, and is great, and redeems His people from all their troubles,

content.hebrew: קהל: וְהִרְבָּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת, וַיִּפְדֵּֽהוּ מִכָּל־עֲוֹנוֹתָיו.
content.english: Cong. And He makes much deliverance for His people, delivering them from all their sins.

content.hebrew: חזן: פְּד֤וּת ׀ שָׁ֘לַ֤ח לְעַמּ֗וֹ צִוָּֽה־לְעוֹלָ֥ם בְּרִית֑וֹ קָד֖וֹשׁ וְנוֹרָ֣א שְׁמֽוֹ: (תהלים קיא:ט)
content.transliteration: Ḥazzan: Pedut, shalaḥ le‘ammo tsivva le‘olam berito ḳadosh venora shemo:
content.english: Cantor. He sent deliverance to His people; He commanded His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name! (Ps. 111:9)

content.hebrew: צַֽהֲלִ֥י וָרֹ֖נִּי יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־גָד֥וֹל בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (ישעיהו יב:ו)
content.transliteration: Tsahali varonni yoshevet tsiyyon ki ḡadol beḳirbekh ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Rejoice and sing out, dweller of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great in Your midst! (Isa. 12:6)

content.hebrew: קהל: גֹּֽאֲלֵ֕נוּ יו֥י צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמ֑וֹ קְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים מז:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Go’alenu Adonai tseva’ot shemo ḳedosh Yisra’el:
content.english: Cong. Our redeemer, Adonai Ẓeva’oth is His name, the Holy One of Israel. (Isa. 47:4)
content.comments: Adonai Ẓeva’oth. A common name for God in Scripture; traditional English: “Lord of Hosts.”
